idiom.title: Horse around
idiom.interpretationEn: This phrase originates from the playful and sometimes reckless nature of horses. It’s used as a figurative expression to describe people engaging in silly, unserious, or aimless behavior.
idiom.interpretationZh: 这个短语源于马匹常常爱嬉戏和奔跑的天性，人们用这一形象化的表达来形容人的打闹和无所事事的状态。通常用来描述那些不严肃的、搞笑的、或者无目的的行为。

examples.en: The kids were horsing around in the living room and broke a vase.
examples.zh: 孩子们在客厅里瞎胡闹，结果打碎了一个花瓶。

examples.en: Stop horsing around, we need to get this project done!
examples.zh: 别瞎闹了，我们需要完成这个项目！

examples.en: They spent the whole afternoon horsing around by the lake.
examples.zh: 他们整个下午都在湖边瞎闹。

people.name: Vincenzo Iaquinta
people.extract: Vincenzo Iaquinta is an Italian former professional footballer who played as a striker.

people.name: Wyatt Teller
people.extract: Wyatt Teller is an American professional football guard for the Houston Texans of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Virginia Tech Hokies.
highlights: Played college football for Virginia Tech Hokies.

people.name: Chung Il-kwon
people.extract: Chung Il-kwon was a South Korean politician, diplomat, and soldier. A general in the Republic of Korea Army, he served as foreign minister 1963 to 1964, and prime minister from 1964 to 1970. He was an ally of President Park Chung Hee.
highlights: South Korean politician, diplomat, and soldier.
